explicit_summary_lines: Kit 1.1.6 adopted through the Kit's own `kit update` (manifest f2cdb65463e0, signature 0ac64fb3bc1affcd1bc7e462); CI pins, entrypoints, command reference and rule inventory follow 1.1.6.

The Lage and the Systemcheck show the Kit version that runs: in the Kit's own repository, an editable install kept the package metadata of its install time and the Lage showed „Kit 1.1.4“ while 1.1.5 ran; the Systemcheck names such a stale install, and a changed Kit package is seen without a restart (AGP_KIT_RUNTIME_VERSION_V1). „Branch wechseln“ reads the origin branches from GitHub itself, so a merged branch that GitHub deleted is no longer offered from a stale local ref (AGP_BRANCH_SWITCH_ORIGIN_LIVE_V1). In the Kit's own repository a work order may name Kit source paths and write Kit source and tests: only a real module run (`-m` before the package, a bare module name, a one-line `-m` command string, or any string under `shell=True`) is still refused (AGP_KIT_GUARD_NOT_FILE_CONTENT_V1). „Task starten“ in „Arbeiten“ refuses main, master and a detached HEAD and points to „Arbeit beginnen“ (AGP_WORK_TASK_NOT_ON_MAIN_V1); uncommitted work on a branch that „Arbeit beginnen“ published is work in progress, no longer a „Störung“ that recommends „Wiederherstellen“ (AGP_FRESH_PUBLISHED_BRANCH_V1); a checkout older than the running app no longer stages its older extension (AGP_EXTENSION_MATCHES_RUNNING_APP_V1); the CI installs ruff, so the lint test runs instead of being skipped, and its eight findings are fixed (AGP_CI_RUFF_V1); the Kit findings register follows Kit 1.1.6: KIT-GF-014, 015 and 086 verified, 070 fixed, KIT-GF-089 recorded (four retest contracts cannot run from the wheel); build `release-0.3.3-r2`.
Kit 1.1.7 adopted through the Kit's own `kit update` (manifest 019d0f970c2c, signature 23cad950e7384be09202e366); CI pins, entrypoints, command reference and rule inventory follow 1.1.7.

Kit findings register follows Kit 1.1.7: the owned-runtime retests run from the wheel again; KIT-GF-067, 070 and 089 verified, 021/032/045 re-verified, no Kit finding left open. The offline branch list no longer offers `origin` (newer Git's origin/HEAD) as a branch; build `release-0.3.3-r3`.
